pr.body:
## What

History-preserving import of `moaz76943-creator/-offline-packs-store` into the unified public target, so no earlier work can be lost.

- **Method:** two-parent merge commit - parent 1 = `main` (`6bf297fab`), parent 2 = source `main` (`ca821e59a`). The source tree is materialised under `content-factory/`, so **no existing target path is overwritten** and every imported file keeps its real history.
- **Content:** 877 files, ≈6.2 MB - packs (204), tools (377), tests (94), standards (36), legal evidence (37), catalog (13), community (8), media, images, docs, state.
- **Inert source CI:** `content-factory/.github` cannot execute - GitHub only runs the repository-root `.github`.
- **Provenance record:** `content-factory/IMPORT_PROVENANCE.md`.
- **Source repository is not retired** (per `AGENTS.md` preservation rule).

## Verification

- `git log -1 --format='%P'` -> `6bf297fab... ca821e59a...` (real merge parents, history reachable).
- `git ls-files content-factory | wc -l` -> 877.
- Secret-shape scan over the imported tree (private-key blocks, `ghp_`/`github_pat_`/`AKIA` prefixes) -> no matches.

## Deliberately NOT done here

No deduplication and no deletion of the overlapping `tools/`/`tests/`/`packs/`/`legal/` paths. Absorbing unique source content into the application tree requires per-file equivalence proof and is queued as a separate change. This PR only guarantees nothing is lost.
